name: com.kryeker.codecoverage-branch
description: Local wrapper over com.unity.testtools.codecoverage 1.2.7 that synthesizes OpenCover BranchPoints from IL (cond branches + switches) and backfills branch summaries, so HTML/Cobertura/SonarQube reports show branch coverage. Visit counts are heuristic (derived from nearby sequence-point hits) because the Unity 2020 Coverage API only exposes sequence points.
